name: Norman Finance
description:
Norman lets you issue invoices and close your books without leaving Claude.

Sync your bank transactions, send invoices, upload receipts, and file taxes — all while talking naturally with Claude. No accounting jargon, no 15 clicks to reconcile an invoice.

What you can do:

• Invoicing — create, send, and track invoices, including recurring and ZUGFeRD e-invoices
• Bookkeeping — categorize transactions, match receipts, and verify entries
• Client management — maintain your client database and contact details
• Tax filing — generate Finanzamt previews, file VAT returns, and track deadlines
• Company overview — check your balance, revenue, and financial health at a glance
• Documents — upload and attach receipts, invoices, and supporting files

Norman securely connects Claude to your financial workspace via OAuth — your password never touches the AI. Built for freelancers and small businesses at the heart of the European economy.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Norman Finance to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Norman Finance to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.norman.finance/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Norman Finance MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Norman Finance lists 67 MCP tools, including categorize_transaction, change_transaction_verification, convert_offer_to_invoice, create_attachment, create_client, create_company_category, create_invoice, create_offer, create_recurring_invoice, create_transaction, create_vendor, and delete_attachment.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Norman Finance?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Norman Finance in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Norman Finance MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Norman Finance requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Norman Finance is developed by Norman AI Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
